basics.name: Shijie Xiao
basics.label: ECE Graduate Student
basics.summary: A highly motivated ECE graduate student at Georgia Tech with a strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, software development, and distributed systems. Experienced in deep learning, computer vision, and real-time systems.

work.name: BrainML Laboratory, Georgia Tech
work.summary: Conducted research on machine learning methods for trajectory analysis to understand animal behavior patterns.
highlights: Developed algorithms to predict mice movement and modeled spatiotemporal interactions using graph structures.
Introduced a novel geodesic loss function that improved prediction performance.

work.name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
work.summary: Worked on diffusion model training with noisy labels for image segmentation tasks.
highlights: Proposed a method for learning from noise-infused labels in semi-supervised settings.
Improved segmentation performance using Stable Diffusion.

work.name: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
work.summary: Focused on denoising OCT medical images using diffusion models.
highlights: Implemented a DDPM-based denoising method to enhance diagnostic accuracy.
Benchmarked against models such as U-Net and TCFL-OCT using PSNR, SSIM, and GCMSE.

education.institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

projects.name: Camera-based Subway Congestion Prevention System
projects.summary: Developed a subway pedestrian detection and posture recognition system using PyTorch and OpenCV.
highlights: Custom dataset collection from surveillance videos of Wuhan Metro.
Real-time congestion detection via pose clustering and crowd flow estimation.

projects.name: eSports Assistant Based on Gaze Behavior
projects.summary: Designed a deep learning system for gaze tracking in eSports.
highlights: Built a cross-frame gaze estimation model using CNNs.
Few-shot learning framework for user adaptation with <50ms latency.

projects.name: Health Management System
projects.summary: C-based system for health code generation, trip card tracking, and epidemic risk management.
highlights: Modular implementation for QR generation and dynamic status updates.
Structured user database with automated location-based evaluations.
